_help: Per upstream model ID. Metadata only when evidenced; parameters are explicit user overrides forwarded to NeuralDeep. Unknown effort remains unknown, not fabricated. max_image_attachments is the gateway-side per-request image budget enforced in protocol.to_openai (measured against NeuralDeep /v1/chat/completions): null = unlimited lane, integer = keep the newest N image parts and replace older ones with a text note.
